title: Dice Mohenjodaro EAMd25.jpg
author: Zunkir
description: Terracotta dice, from Mohenjo-daro (Pakistan). From Mohenjo-daro, Mature Harrapean period, c. 2600-1900 BC. This Indus cubical die is unusual in that its opposite sides add up to seven as in modern dice. Ashmolean Museum https://collections.ashmolean.org/object/356338
